notes: One capital-account rollforward table across three period columns (1st Quarter 2017, Year-to-Date, Inception-to-Date); all rows kept to fund_economics_observation since Beginning/Ending capital anchor the whole table and that family alone covers every row's category. Purchased interest and Assignment of interest print dash across all three columns and yield no records. Current income tax expense, Deferred income tax benefit (expense), and Net income tax benefit (expense) are excluded: no tax category exists in this family's controlled list and none of commitment/paid_in_capital/income/fee/carried_interest/gain_loss honestly describes a tax line. Net realized and unrealized gain (loss) is excluded as a blended subtotal of two distinct controlled categories (realized_gain_loss and unrealized_gain_loss, both separately extracted); tagging it as either would misstate it.

notes: Two small supplemental tables under one 'Supplemental Information' section heading. The three 'Less: Cumulative contributions for...' lines are cumulative totals by purpose so are tagged paid_in_capital, matching the Total-Contributions convention rather than a single-period contribution. The two 'Plus:' add-back lines match recallable_distribution: LPA-defined proceeds that get added back to available/unfunded commitment rather than permanently reducing it.
